rationale: A 25-year-old cryptography mystery was actually resolved this week, and the resolution is both a correction and a joke in the same fact.
text: For 25 years people suspected the NSA hand-picked the seeds behind NIST P-256. The answer, published this week: someone called srand48(871696354), which is just the clock reading 01:52:34 UTC on 16 August 1997, and kept grinding until candidate number 1,842 gave a valid curve.
